name: Bukhara almond
desc: A wild almond of the Central Asian foothills that grows at roughly 1,000 to 1,800 m. The cinereous vulture nests in Bukhara almond trees in this range, per the Key Biodiversity Areas factsheet.
about: Prunus bucharica is a species of wild almond native to Tajikistan, Uzbekistan and Afghanistan, preferring to grow at 1000-1800 m above sea level.
